notes.title: Hidden Visions
notes.content:
The Hidden Visions update adds a new layer of exploration to the world of Path of Clicks.

Secret locations are now scattered throughout familiar maps, waiting to be revealed by sharp eyes — or rather, by the powerful "Eye of Revelation". This special item unveils hidden paths.

Consumable items also make their debut: discover food that grants temporary bonuses and mystical totems that unlock special abilities.
Use them wisely.
